notes.title: Update : Full Controller Support + Bug Fixes + Performance!
notes.notes:
🎮 Full Controller Support
Our #1 requested feature is finally here!

Full support across combat, menus, UI, and interactive camera.

Visible button glyphs for seamless navigation.

Controller remapping in both Main Menu & Gameplay.
Now you can fight, explore, and enjoy all the spicy details, fully on your controller. 💦

🔧 Ladder & Platforming Fixes

Fixed getting stuck while climbing (no more forced restarts!).

Stepping off ladders now works smoothly.

Abilities disabled while climbing to prevent glitches.
The entire system feels far smoother and more reliable.

🌀 Gameplay & Interaction

Fixed attacks/abilities triggering during interactive animations or altars.

Fixed camera bugs when using teleporter.

🌿 Performance & Environment

Marshes optimized and now runs smoothly!

Fixed dungeon clipping issues where sky was visible behind doors/ladders.
